title: 第17章 偷袭你的狗贼第18章 三不原则
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
苍天可见，她真的是无心的啊啊啊啊。
她眼珠转了一圈，心想要不趁着他们还在抓狂的间隙跑路吧。
她还不想死。
就在她胡思乱想的时候，两道人影一左一右地出现在了她的身侧。
顾玄的剑架在她左肩上，剑刃离她的脖子不到一寸。
姜珊的匕首抵在她腰侧，刀尖正好对准她的肾。
两个人像拎小鸡一样，一左一右架住她的胳膊，把她整个人从地上拎了起来，拖着她往前走。
宁楚的双脚在地上划出两道深深的沟，顾玄和姜珊的修为在她之上，高阶修士释放的威压让她这个筑基九层的小菜鸡完全动弹不得。
直到她被拖到鹤隐舟面前，顾玄和姜珊同时松手，宁楚往前踉跄了一步，稳住身体，抬头对上那双淡漠的眼睛。
“小师叔，偷袭你的狗贼被我们抓到了，交给你处置！”
宁楚站在他面前，浑身都在发抖。
鹤隐舟低头看着她，他的额头还在往外渗血，血珠顺着鼻梁滑到下巴，滴在他白色的衣袍上。
两人对视，鹤隐舟的眼睛忽然失去焦距，身形微晃，直直朝她的方向倒了下来。
宁楚瞪大眼眸，一时不知该扶还是该躲，犹豫间，眼前一黑，鹤隐舟高大的身躯已经倒在了她身上。
重量压过来的瞬间，宁楚听见自己的肋骨发出一声悲鸣。
她的身体本来就因为经脉受损而摇摇欲坠，哪里经得住一个成年男人的重量，整个人被压得连连后退，脚跟踩到一块凸起的树根，身体失去平衡。
仰面摔倒在地，后脑勺磕在一块石头上，眼前顿时金星乱冒。
而鹤隐舟正正好好地压在她身上。
他的头靠在她的肩膀上，散落的长发铺了她一脸，那些头发凉丝丝的，还有血的味道。
她的大脑一片空白，一股腥甜的味道从喉咙里涌了上来。

宁楚偏头咳出一口血，眼皮耷拉下去，意识陷入了沉沉的黑暗。
昏迷前的最后一秒，她看见周围还在发呆的四个人突然尖叫起来，手忙脚乱地冲过来。
不知时间过去多久，宁楚再睁眼时，入目是一个陌生又熟悉的洞府。
洞府的陈设很简单，一张暖玉床，一张石桌，两把椅子，桌上放着一壶茶和两只倒扣的茶杯。石头被打磨得很光滑，边角处刻着天剑宗特有的云纹。
洞府的灵气很足，比她这几天住过的任何一个地方都足，吸一口就感觉浑身舒坦。
她这是，回天剑宗了？
思及此，她翻身下床，身体并不怎么难受，损伤的经脉也修复了不少，应该有人在她昏迷时给她治疗过。
她走到门口，准备出去，被一道无形的屏障挡了回来。
宁楚认真一看，才发现门口被设了禁制，起码要元婴期修士才能强行打破禁制出去。
她叹了口气，转头走到窗户边，推开窗一看，外面熟悉的风景看得她鼻尖一酸。
果然是天剑宗。
远处层层叠叠的山峰，云雾缭绕，仙鹤在山腰间盘旋，远处的瀑布从高处垂落，发出隐隐约约的水声。
一百八十八年，她看了无数次，从没想过有一天还会再看到它。
content_en:
Heaven can see that she was really unintentional.
She rolled her eyes, thinking about running away while they were still freaking out.
She doesn't want to die yet.
Just when she was thinking wildly, two figures appeared beside her, one on the left and one on the right.
Gu Xuan's sword was placed on her left shoulder, and the blade was less than an inch away from her neck.
Jiang Shan's dagger was pressed against her waist, with the tip pointed right at her kidney.
The two people held her arms one on the left and the other like a chicken, lifted her up from the ground, and dragged her forward.
Ning Chu's feet carved two deep grooves on the ground. Gu Xuan and Jiang Shan's cultivation levels were higher than hers. The pressure released by the high-level monks made her, a novice on the ninth floor of the foundation, completely unable to move.
Until she was dragged in front of He Yinzhou, Gu Xuan and Jiang Shan let go at the same time. Ning Chu staggered forward, stabilized her body, and raised her head to meet those indifferent eyes.
"Uncle Junior, the dog thief who attacked you was caught by us, and we will leave it to you to deal with!"
Ning Chu stood in front of him, trembling all over.
He Yinzhou looked down at her, blood was still oozing from his forehead, and blood beads slid down the bridge of his nose to his chin, dripping on his white robe.
The two looked at each other, and He Yinzhou's eyes suddenly lost focus, his body swayed slightly, and he fell straight in her direction.
Ning Chu's eyes widened, and she didn't know whether to support or hide for a moment. During her hesitation, her vision went dark, and He Yinzhou's tall body had fallen on her.
The moment the weight came over, Ning Chu heard a scream from his ribs.
Her body was already shaky due to the damage to her meridians. It could not withstand the weight of an adult man. Her whole body was pressed backwards, her heels stepped on a raised tree root, and her body lost balance.
He fell to the ground on his back and hit the back of his head on a stone. Stars suddenly appeared in front of his eyes.
And He Yinzhou was right on top of her.
His head rested on her shoulder, and his long hair spread all over her face. The hair was cool and smelled of blood.
Her mind went blank, and a fishy-sweet taste surged up from her throat.
Ning Chu tilted his head and coughed out a mouthful of blood, his eyelids drooped, and his consciousness fell into deep darkness.
At the last second before she fell into coma, she saw the four people around her who were still in a daze suddenly screamed and rushed over in a hurry.
I don’t know how much time passed, but when Ning Chu opened his eyes again, he saw a strange yet familiar cave.
The furnishings of the cave are very simple, including a warm jade bed, a stone table, and two chairs. There is a pot of tea and two upside-down teacups on the table. The stone was polished very smooth, and the corners were engraved with the unique cloud patterns of the Tianjian Sect.
The aura of the cave was very strong, more so than any other place she had stayed in these past few days. She felt comfortable all over after taking one breath.
Is she returning to the Tianjian Sect?
Thinking of this, she rolled over and got out of bed. Her body didn't feel very uncomfortable, and the damaged meridians had also been repaired a lot. Someone should have treated her when she was in a coma.
She walked to the door and was about to go out, but was blocked by an invisible barrier.
Ning Chu took a closer look and found that there was a restriction on the door. At least a Nascent Soul Stage monk could forcefully break the restriction and get out.
She sighed, turned around and walked to the window, opened it and took a look. The familiar scenery outside made the tip of her nose sore.
It was indeed the Tianjian Sect.
There are stacks of mountain peaks in the distance, shrouded in clouds and mist, cranes hovering on the mountainside, and distant waterfalls falling from high places, making a faint sound of water.
In one hundred and eighty-eight years, she had seen it countless times, never thinking that one day she would see it again.
